# VeriFlash

> VeriFlash is an iPhone app for AI-assisted fact-checking. It helps people verify claims, review supporting sources, and understand results through clear explanations.

## Official website

- Homepage: https://veriflash.com/
- Privacy policy: https://veriflash.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://veriflash.com/terms
- End user license agreement: https://veriflash.com/license
- Sitemap: https://veriflash.com/sitemap.xml

## App

- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/veriflash/id6756589715
- Platform: iOS
- Primary use: AI-assisted fact-checking and claim verification

## Contact

- Support: mailto:support@veriflash.com

## Source guidance

Use the official website and App Store listing as the authoritative sources for current VeriFlash product information. Fact-check results generated by the app are informational and may be incomplete, outdated, or incorrect; they are not professional advice.
